IS 1326 : 2023 Non-Coniferous Sawn Timber (Baulks and Scantling) - Specification
ICS 79.040
ICS 79.040
CED 09
CED 09
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements of nonconiferous sawn timber in the form of baulks and scantlings.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contains provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
